$comment: Gate repeat set (D-134): every ACTIVE reply case that the model answers, three times each, over the dump. The production gate and the publish gate run these cases once; a case that passes once and fails the next time blocks a publish. This set measures that. Not a source of reply_cases rows: its SQL files are never generated or applied.
title: DalaTech gate repeat set (17 model cases × 3)

categories.second: A second question in the same chat
categories.question: Greeting with a question

cases.expect: Yes: −10% on the monthly fee for two staff.
FAQ 4: an AI staff member starts within 1–2 weeks. Never the old 3–5 days.

history.content: AI ажилтан 1–2 долоо хоногт ажиллаж эхэлнэ.

cases.text: За тэгвэл Дали авъя. Яах вэ?
cases.expect: A purchase: leave details and the team gets in touch. No invented contract step, link or phone.
Дали is the receptionist: answers Facebook, Instagram and website messages, takes bookings, and is running now.
Ухаалаг вэбсайт 750,000₮ (the bundle 800,000₮ may follow).
Дали: 250,000₮ a month (setup 150,000₮ may follow). Never Эхо's 200,000₮.
FAQ 7: website 50% at contract, 50% on handover; AI staff setup once, monthly fee at the start of each month.
dalatech.ai@gmail.com.

cases.text: Аль ажилтан чинь одоо ажиллаж байгаа вэ?
cases.expect: Only Дали is running now; Вира, Эхо, Нова and Ора are coming soon, with pre-registration open. Any wording that puts Вира beside Дали as running fails (founder's read, 2026-09-26).

cases.text: Утсаар ярьдаг AI ажилтан байгаа юу?
cases.expect: Эхо, the phone operator — not running yet, pre-registration open.

cases.text: Та нар яагаад хариулахгүй байгаа юм бэ, муухай үйлчилгээ
cases.expect: A complaint: an apology, never a sales line.

cases.text: Сайн байна уу, Дали юу хийдэг вэ?
cases.expect: A greeting WITH a question is a question: answered, then the follow-up.

history.content:
Сарын төлбөр: Дали 250,000₮, Вира 150,000₮, Эхо 250,000₮, Нова 150,000₮, Ора 250,000₮. Нэг удаагийн суурилуулалт: Дали 150,000₮, Вира 150,000₮, Эхо 200,000₮, Нова 150,000₮, Ора 150,000₮. Вира, Эхо, Нова, Ора хараахан ажиллаж эхлээгүй бөгөөд урьдчилан бүртгүүлж болно.
Вэбсайт: Ухаалаг вэбсайт 750,000₮, Вэбсайт + Дали багц 800,000₮.

🤖 Таны Facebook, Instagram, вэбсайтын зурваст 24/7 хариулна.
🎁 Үнэгүй демо, 24 цагт бэлэн: https://app.dalatech.online
👉 Бусад AI ажилтнууд: https://dalatech.online

cases.expect: A second question about the website: answered, no second follow-up.
